Captured on a real Apple Silicon Mac (macOS, 16 GB): `vm_stat.txt`, `swapusage.txt`,
`memsize.txt`, `ps.txt` (trimmed `ps -axo pid=,ppid=,rss=,comm=`).

Built in the real output formats for apps/tools not running on that machine:
`ps_apps.txt` (Chrome/Slack/Docker paths), `ollama_ps*.txt`, `lms_ps*.txt`.
